criteria.evidence: 1405.5 -> 1059.7s = 696.6 x 1.5213, the multiplier the 360->560 raise established and two later raises reused. criteria.evidence: CI: 157/157 named reds with no collateral at ee1d5be (before, 1276.4s) and at every head of this PR — 844.3s, 839.8s, 782.9s, 882.0s, 874.5s at the intermediate selection and 679.4s, 672.7s, 687.4s at the final one — with 10/10 guard self-checks in all eight.
